overall_reason: A large tiered token set (770 tokens, semantic roles such as --color-text-tertiary referenced 122 times) themes the page, and the drift sits mostly inside the product mockups: near-identical dark fills and borders, a 9px radius beside 8px, and 14 one-off shadows.

score.reason: T-TOKEN-TIERS and T-SCALE-FIT pass on the page's chrome; T-DRIFT-PAIRS and T-VALUE-INVENTORY find near-duplicate surfaces and shadow recipes, and T-HARDCODE finds retyped literals (TOK-010, TOK-004, TOK-006).

findings.where: product mockup panels and carousel cards, 1440 (tiles/1440-01.png)
findings.evidence: Dark surfaces pair #0f1011 (34 elements) with #101112 and #121414, and #08090a with #090a0b (values.1440.colour_fill near_duplicates); borders pair #23252a with #24282c and #2e2e32 with #2a2a2d. Muted text pairs #62666d (130) with #626366 (3).
findings.after: One panel-surface token and one panel-border token in the mockups
findings.why: The values are invisible apart and multiply what a theme change has to touch.

findings.evidence: Fourteen shadow recipes render and none equals a declared shadow token (values.1440.shadow on_token_share 0.0), although 12 shadow tokens exist. The sweep's card_kit hit names three card recipes (12px with a 32px blur, 8px with a 1px ring, 4px with an inset 12px).
findings.after: Two or three elevation tokens (ring, raised, overlay) referenced by every card and popover
findings.why: A shadow family past three recipes stops reading as a scale of elevation.

findings.evidence: The comment cards use a 9px radius (18 elements) beside the 8px radius used on 28 other containers (values.1440.radius examples, KFZpfa_commentCard).
findings.after: The comment cards use the 8px radius token
findings.why: A 1px radius difference is invisible and only adds a value.

findings.evidence: 400 spacing, 267 radius, 108 font-size and 91 colour literals equal a declared token's value (declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value), for example .TBAOqq_toast padding 16px and .GJ9TEa_carouselCard background #0f1011.
findings.why: Retyped values drift silently the next time the token changes.

strengths: Semantic text roles (--color-text-tertiary, --color-text-quaternary) carry the muted text and are among the most referenced tokens.
The dark theme redefines 72 base tokens under one attribute selector and its rules set no literal colours (theme.dark_rules_colour_declarations literal 0).
Spacing sits on a 4px scale (share 0.895 against chance 0.3) and type sizes are 100% on token values at 1440.
The page uses two families only (Inter Variable and Berkeley Mono).
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the light scheme as rendered: the capture shows dark; 58 tokens are set only by the data-theme attribute and 18 also by the media query, read but not seen
most small text (10 to 15px) belongs to the product mockups, which are exhibits; their sizes were not held to the page's type scale
T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: the framer, primer and open_props hits are a few name collisions, not a framework in use
